cnn_score_direction: lower CNN RMSE is predicted to rank lower simulator THD
candidate_sampling: Independent uniform draws on [0,360) degrees for cell 2 and cell 3; cell 1 fixed at 0 degrees.
score_definition: RMSE in volts between denormalized CNN target-voltage prediction and that simulator candidate analytical reference waveform.
evaluation_note: One simulator waveform generation and one event-based total-THD evaluation per candidate; CNN score is only a ranking proxy.
